main_text.head: PROOEMIVM DE CONFIRMATIONE Institutionum.a [illegible, ~24 letters] Institu- [illegible, ~8 letters] Theophil.
IN NOMINE DOMINI nostri Iesu Christi. ||
main_text.p: IMPERATOR Caesar Flauius Iustinianus, Alamanicus, Gothicus, Francicus, Germanicus, Anticus, Alanicus, Vandalicus, Africanus, Pius, Felix, inclytus, victor, ac triumphator, semper Augustus, cupida legum iuuentuti. [S.D.]

IMPERATORIAM maiestatem nō solum armis decorata, sed {b}etiā b non minus legibus quam armis respublica defenditur. l.4. C. de adnoc. diuers. iudic.legibus oportet esse armatam, vt vtrumque tempus, & bellorum, & pacis, rectè posset gubernari: & princeps Romanus non solum in hostilibus praeliis victor existat, sed etiā per legitimos tramites, calumniantium iniquitates c eorū praecipuē qui scientes volētes delinquūt. l. 2. ff. de Iustitiaexpellat: {d}& haec tam iuris religiosissimus, {c}quàm victis hostibus triumphator magnificus.d docendo. l.8.l.9.Cod.de legibus.& puniendo.ff.de poenis.

Quorum vtramque viam cum summis vigiliis, summáque prouidentia, annuente Deo, perfecimus. Et bellicos quidem sudores nostros Barbaricae gentes sub iuga nostra redactae cognoscunt, & tam Africa, quàm aliae innumerae prouinciae, post {f}tanta temporum spatia, nostris victoriis à coelesti numine praestitis, iterum ditioni Romanae, nostroque additae imperio, protegatur.f Africa, post 95. annos. l. 1. Cod. de off. pr. Prat. Afr. Procop: Italia post 60. Omnes vero populi legibus tam à nobis promulgatis, quàm compositis, reguntur. 2 ¶ Et cùm {g}constitutiones, antea confusas, in lucidulentam ereximus consonantiam: tunc nostram extendimus curam ad immensa {h}veteris prudentiae volumina: & opus desperatum, quasi per medium profundum euntes, coelesti fauore iam adimpleuimus.g & priore Codice, qui hodie non extat, intelligit.h 2000. librorum. 3000000. versuum. v. conf. ad mag. Senatum. §.1.

3 ¶ Cumque hoc, Deo propitio, peractum est: Triboniano viro magnifico, magistro, & exquaestore sacri palatij nostri, ||& excolule|| necnō Theophilo, & Dorotheo, viris illustribus, antecessoribus, (quorum omnium solertiam, & legum scientiam, & circa no-

page.notes: The Greek note at the top right (note a) could not be read letter by letter, so it is marked illegible; only the Latin words "Institu-" and "Theophil." are read. The mark "{c}" before "quàm" and the margin note "c" (eorum praecipuē) may not be placed exactly as printed: the mark in the text and the margin note sit on neighbouring lines and could belong to different marks. The word "Anticus" is copied as printed. "||& excolule||": the word is uncertain and may be "excoluè" or similar; the bars are printed. The line "lucidulentam" in "in lucidulentam ereximus" is a guess from the scan; the word may read "lucululentam" or "in lucu-lentam", so it should be checked. The margin notes are copied from the scan at the reduced size and some abbreviations may differ. The heading "IN NOMINE DOMINI" was treated as a level 2 heading, and the title block as level 1. The page ends mid-word "no-" with the printed hyphen, and the text continues on the next page.
